# telnyx_agent_gateway_policies (Data Source)

Lists agent gateway policies, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_agent_gateway_policy`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gateway_id` (String) The gateway id.

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `agent_gateway_policies` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agent_gateway_policies))

<a id="nestedatt--agent_gateway_policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agent_gateway_policies`

Read-Only:

- `base` (String) A policy this one builds on, by name. The policy starts with the base's guardrails.
- `created_at` (String) When the policy's current version was created. An update creates a new version.
- `description` (String) What the policy is for.
- `guardrails` (Attributes) The guardrails a policy adds to its base's, and the ones it removes from them, by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agent_gateway_policies--guardrails))
- `model` (String) A condition on the model, by name or regular expression. The policy's guardrails run only on requests for a matching model. `null` matches every model.
- `name` (String) A name, unique on the instance. A request names the policy in its `policies` field.
- `pipeline` (Attributes) Ordered steps, in place of the guardrails running independently. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agent_gateway_policies--pipeline))
- `updated_at` (String) When the policy last changed.

<a id="nestedatt--agent_gateway_policies--guardrails"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agent_gateway_policies.guardrails`

Read-Only:

- `add` (Set of String) Guardrails the policy runs in addition to its base's.
- `remove` (Set of String) Guardrails from its base that the policy does not run.


<a id="nestedatt--agent_gateway_policies--pipeline"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agent_gateway_policies.pipeline`

Read-Only:

- `hook` (String) `before_request` runs the steps on the request, and `after_request` on the model's response.
- `steps` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agent_gateway_policies--pipeline--steps))

<a id="nestedatt--agent_gateway_policies--pipeline--steps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agent_gateway_policies.pipeline.steps`

Read-Only:

- `guardrail` (String) A guardrail on the instance, by name.
- `message` (String) The response that replaces the model's when an outcome is `respond`. Required with `respond`.
- `on_error` (String) What happens when the guardrail errors. Left out, the same as `on_fail`.
- `on_fail` (String) What happens when the guardrail fails.
- `on_pass` (String) What happens when the guardrail passes. `next` goes on to the next step, `allow` allows the request, `block` blocks it, and `respond` answers with `message`.
- `pass_data` (Boolean) `true` hands the step's modified request, such as masked text, to the next step.
